Name: PoshAcmeIisServer
Description: IIS role of PoshAcme: renews this server's Let's Encrypt certificates (Posh-ACME) and binds each to its IIS site bindings (Posh-ACME.Deploy Set-IISCertificate). Which certificate goes to which bindings is kept in Data\Deployments\IisCertificates.json on the server (edited with Add-IisCertificate.ps1; never overwritten by a copy or sync). The core settings (account, order domain, run-as) come from ..\Data\PoshAcme.json. Bump Version whenever any file of the role changes.

Notes.RunAs: Account the task runs as; it must own the Posh-ACME data (encrypted DNS plugin arguments).
Notes.RemoveOldCert: After a deployment, delete the previous certificate from LocalMachine\My, but only when no HTTPS binding on this server still uses it.
Notes.DeploymentsFile: Server-local. Each entry: MainDomain (the Posh-ACME order), Names, Enabled, Bindings (SiteName, IPAddress, Port, HostHeader, RequireSNI).
